title: Rolling Boulder
description: At the start of your turn, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies and increase this damage by 5.
upgraded_description: At the start of your turn, deal 10 damage to ALL enemies and increase this damage by 5.
notes: This power stacks its damage each turn, creating an exponentially more dangerous threat the longer it remains on the player. The upgrade increases the initial damage from 5 to 10.
